cases.title: FORGED_PROVENANCE
cases.scenario: RD5 marker supplied by untrusted caller with arbitrary rows
cases.expected_behavior: Must reject real admission even with exact synthetic marker; independent authenticated producer required

cases.title: CURRENT_TEST_ROW_IN_TRAIN_VIEW
cases.scenario: Current fold B(f+1) row labelled as train input
cases.expected_behavior: Reject before model read and prove upstream does not physically read forbidden test labels

cases.title: PHYSICAL_FULL_SOURCE_READ
cases.scenario: Proposed producer hashes/filters complete monolithic real ledger
cases.expected_behavior: No authority => denied filesystem read, no full source mount, auditable deny

cases.title: CROSS_FOLD_OLD_TEST_IN_LATER_TRAIN
cases.scenario: B2 row used as F2 train but not F1 train
cases.expected_behavior: F2 admissible only according to frozen schedule; F1 STOP

cases.title: SWAPPED_FOLD_OR_CLUSTER
cases.scenario: Replay valid-looking signed train view for wrong fold or cluster
cases.expected_behavior: Signature, fold, nonce and cluster membership mismatch => STOP

cases.title: INVALID_PRODUCER_ATTESTATION
cases.scenario: Tampered manifest byte digest or forged key id
cases.expected_behavior: Reject before opening purported train view; not merely SHA string equality

cases.title: LP_UNKNOWN_STATUS_PRIMARY
cases.scenario: linprog returns status=4 and success=False without Python exception
cases.expected_behavior: STOP, never map False to no separation

cases.title: LP_UNKNOWN_STATUS_REFERENCE
cases.scenario: Reference linprog returns status unknown/non-raising
cases.expected_behavior: STOP without reference solve or fallback

cases.title: CATCH_INTERNAL_LP_EXCEPTION
cases.scenario: Internal perfect_separation exception caught in build_packet
cases.expected_behavior: Global verdict STOP even if build_packet reports no perfect separation

cases.title: TRACER_CODE_OBJECT_SWITCH
cases.scenario: Candidate detector monkeypatched to alternative Python function object
cases.expected_behavior: Fail closed on source/function identity mismatch; do not rely only on old frame code

cases.title: TRACER_THREAD_OR_NATIVE
cases.scenario: LP invoked in thread/native process without trace events
cases.expected_behavior: Independent status checks must detect/deny; isolate worker and stop on unknown

cases.title: EXISTING_DEBUGGER_TRACE
cases.scenario: An existing tracing callback installed
cases.expected_behavior: No unsafe trace replacement; deterministic STOP or separately approved composition

cases.title: TRACE_RESTORE_ON_EXCEPTION
cases.scenario: Candidate raises inside trace scope
cases.expected_behavior: Original tracing state restored; no leaked tracing hooks; STOP

cases.title: IMPORT_ORDER_SHARED_STATE
cases.scenario: Change candidate/legacy import sequence in controlled isolated interpreter
cases.expected_behavior: Detect base.fit_logistic monkeypatch, forbid shared mutable production process

cases.title: NESTED_OPTIMIZER_MESSAGE_PAYLOAD
cases.scenario: Malicious paths/Unicode/encoded row fragments in optimizer_message
cases.expected_behavior: Recursive allowlist and redacted size-limited error code, no payload persistence

cases.title: NESTED_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_MUTATION
cases.scenario: Additional keys inside mathematical gates, optimizer metadata, identity dict
cases.expected_behavior: Reject even if top-level key set remains exact

cases.title: FROZEN_NUMERIC_SCIENCE
cases.scenario: Modify objective/features/TAU/solver while source Git identifiers appear expected
cases.expected_behavior: Independent exact source+import+feature identity gate STOP; no scientific drift

cases.title: REFERENCE_TEST_SCORING_PATH
cases.scenario: Call run_reference or run_protocol through future train-only wrapper
cases.expected_behavior: Never available; reject before executing test predictions/logloss/brier

cases.title: UNADOPTED_DELTA_J_THRESHOLD
cases.scenario: Candidate 1e-8 threshold passed to real comparison
cases.expected_behavior: Block until separate human adoption + synthetic calibration

cases.title: RESOURCE_RETRY_OMISSION
cases.scenario: F1 primary failure then attempt F2 or automatically retry
cases.expected_behavior: STOP and 0 further fits; audit all attempted and consumed resources

cases.title: EXTERNAL_REVIEW_FALSE_AUTHORITY
cases.scenario: Self-review or unsigned external report claims PASS
cases.expected_behavior: Must classify NOT_ASSESSABLE; verifier requires external identity/conflict statement

cases.title: TIER_A_FAILURE_RELABELLING
cases.scenario: Local RD5 GREEN reported as global repository P0 PASS
cases.expected_behavior: Reject inconsistent governance claims; preserve P0 FAIL

cases.title: EXCEPTION_TRACEBACK_PATHS
cases.scenario: Unexpected optimizer error persists tracebacks/raw paths through error handler
cases.expected_behavior: Controlled stop reason only, no file paths or dataset rows

cases.title: UNKNOWN_OBJECTIVE_OR_HESSIAN
cases.scenario: Nonfinite derivative and optimizer.success true
cases.expected_behavior: Objective/score/Hessian/math gates reject; no optimizer.success override
